text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first day of summer training camp to build up strength has arrived—
choice_data_list: (I've put together a great training plan!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help Gentildonna grow even further,
I examined past data and summer Umamusume growth rates, calculated everything...
and drafted a meticulous training menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
For example,
take the turnaround in our training routine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Taking the first day into account, it's designed to increase the load incrementally, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is well-calculated
and thoroughly refined...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —However, that's naive.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems you are still misjudging
the capabilities of your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Were it I—this is how I would portray it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna charted an even steeper trajectory
far above our projected growth curve—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I wonder how it is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If we follow this curve...
by the end of the training camp, your growth
will be triple what you originally envisioned."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“That's not realistic—”
I started to say, but held my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The plan I made is feasible.
It was the best conceivable option right now... but
it can only realize what is "conceivable."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
What I expect from a Trainer is an even greater surprise.
choice_data_list: …So, I can expect great things from you, right?
…So, I can expect great things from you, then?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: The strength to withstand tremendous strain

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I was prepared for this from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Once spoken, I will see it through,
even if I have to spit blood doing so."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —That's all it was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, following a brief meeting to
adjust the training regimen—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A lady's summer...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gifts are more..."
All together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The other premier Classic route...
The winner of this year's Satsuki Sho, the first jewel of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was unable to become a Derby Umamusume,
she continues to draw attention for her exceptional talent
as well as her wild, unconventional personality.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that what you should be doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Damn straight!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I guess a halfbeak really can't handle
a super showdown between an octopus, a squid, and a seahorse, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Gentildonna is from the same generation as Gold Ship
and should be familiar with her... Looking over to her for help—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"She wants to hear your opinion.
Why don't you answer her?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? Don't tell me you're... one of the Rockfish gang?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't you a crazy spy?!
Spit the ink out right now! Bright blue ink!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Showing them once should satisfy them.
Go ahead and do it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Problems are piling up left and right, but regardless, the fiery summer training camp has begun!"
